purpose: Independent relevance-v2 media topics fixed before their first embedding or retrieval evaluation.
filename_policy: Only the opaque path basename is copied into the indexed corpus. Titles, attribution, transcripts, novelty rationales, queries and absence requirements are evaluation metadata and must never be indexed.
label_policy: Exactly one English and one Chinese positive query plus a translated English/Chinese no-answer pair per topic. No labels were selected using model scores.
